verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials, such as tokens with selectable scopes, for an agent. The only related claims are vague marketing lines: agents work 'inside the guardrails you set' and keep secrets 'under your existing permissions'. These describe adjacent permission behavior, not a credential-issuance capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
